description: Start capturing real UI from the app running on this machine for tday.com features. Reads each feature's context from tday.com (what it is, where it likely lives in the code, what is missing), records the git branch/commit and the repo's current status (to prove it is left clean), and opens a browser on the dev server. Start the dev server first. A desktop app built on Chromium (Electron) is captured in its own window: start it with a debugging port (electron: --remote-debugging-port=9222; electron-vite dev: --remoteDebuggingPort 9222) and pass cdpUrl instead of appUrl.

appUrl.description: The running app's address, e.g. http://localhost:3000 (not needed with cdpUrl)

cdpUrl.description: A running desktop app's debugging address on this machine, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222, to capture in its own window

featureIds.description: tday.com feature ids from the capture prompt or demo_features (empty = all features a capture prompt's token allows)

headed.description: Show the browser window (e.g. to let the developer sign in)

repoDir.description: The repo root (default: the current directory)

storageState.description: A Playwright storage-state JSON file with a signed-in session

window.description: With cdpUrl: part of the address of the app window to capture, when it has several

name: capture_start
title: Start a tday.com capture
